verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state pointing any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with a single API key, and this is independently confirmed by the llms.txt probe describing the base URL as 'OpenAI-compatible.' A community user also confirms getting an OpenAI-compatible client (llm.datasette.io) working against Morph's endpoint. missing for 10: no first-party code sample showing base_url/api_key override in an SDK snippet, and no broader independent corroboration beyond one community report.
